title: Future Ideas to be referred before planning next scene
instruction: Read this ledger before planning any new scene. Ideas are inspirations, not automatically canon or approved scenes.

ideas.relationship: Karan and Aman are adult twin brothers and Kabir's younger brothers; they are Ankita's devars
ideas.briefScene: A future late-evening at home: Ankita and twins Karan and Aman have an informal cards/game night or small home party. Kabir may be away or delayed for a credible, separately grounded reason, but this is NOT a prerequisite. The three share familiar banter informed by established earlier episodes; if a genuinely new accident or unexpected reversal grows organically out of the game, it may change the mood and end with an abrupt departure. None of those exact steps is confirmed: we may keep only the cards premise, modify the turning point, or discard the whole scene.
ideas.purpose: Offer a credible, distinctive follow-up for Ankita–Karan–Aman after EP03's scooter/household history without adding one more major incident to Jan 1.
